title: Inport
text: Create input port for subsystem or external input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Port dimensions (-1 for inherited)} sets Port dimensions; {Port number} sets the position of port on parent block, {Icon display}, {Latch input by delaying outside signal} sets the option to latch signal by delay, {Latch input for feedback signals of function-call subsystem outputs} sets the latch signal from changing, {Connect Inputs} sets the option to open Root Inport Mapper tool, {Output function call} sets the option to produce function-call event, {Minimum}, {Maximum}, {Data type} sets the output data type Inherit, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data, {Output as nonvirtual bus} sets the option to specify virtuality of bus output, {Unit (e.g., m, m/s^2, N*m)} sets the physical unit of the input signal to the block, {Variable-size signal} sets the option to allow or disallow variable-size signals, {Signal type} sets the output signal type, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the option to specify sample time, {Interpolate data} sets the option to linearly interpolate output data and {Events} sets the option to trigger model partition based on flow of data into port cell array of event trigger. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Port number
params.values: Position of port on parent block 1 (default) | real integer

params.name: Icon display
params.values: Icon display Port number (default) | Signal name | Port number and signal name

params.name: Latch input by delaying outside signal
params.values: Option to latch signal by delay off (default) | on

params.name: Latch input for feedback signals of function-call subsystem outputs
params.values: Latch signal from changing off (default) | on

params.name: Connect Inputs
params.values: Option to open Root Inport Mapper tool button

params.name: Output function call
params.values: Option to produce function-call event off (default) | on

params.name: Data type
params.values: Output data type Inherit: auto (default) | double | single | half | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 |...

params.name: Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on

params.name: Output as nonvirtual bus
params.values: Option to specify virtuality of bus output off (default) | on

params.name: Unit (e.g., m, m/s^2, N*m)
params.values: Physical unit of the input signal to the block inherit (default) | <Enter unit>

params.name: Variable-size signal
params.values: Option to allow or disallow variable-size signals Inherit (default) | No | Yes

params.name: Signal type
params.values: Output signal type auto (default) | real | complex

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: Option to specify sample time -1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Interpolate data
params.values: Option to linearly interpolate output data on (default) | off

params.name: Events
params.values: Option to trigger model partition based on flow of data into port cell array of event trigger objects
